description:
The Open Source Alternative To Notion.

AppFlowy is an open source alternative to Notion.
You are in charge of your data and customizations.
### 🚀 v0.14.10

#### New Features

• **Database side peek** — Added a resizable panel for editing row pages beside their database. Added navigation through visible rows and switching between side peek, center peek, full page, and a new tab while preserving edits.

#### Improvements

• **Charts and lists** — Refreshed chart settings, labels, and tooltips, and corrected calculations using currency and percentage values. Adapted list rows to narrow windows, with properties below the title when space is limited.
• **Database loading** — Opened cached views and row pages without waiting for server refreshes, and loaded initial board cards without fetching every row. Improved recovery from interrupted downloads and displayed available rows while missing rows recovered. Local databases completed loading without remote requests.
• **Cloud creation** — Saved new pages and database rows on the server before exposing them for editing, with loading feedback and recovery for interrupted creation requests.
• **Updates and errors** — Unified desktop update prompts with release notes, download links, and server compatibility guidance. Replaced technical error text with clearer localized messages and guidance when an action's outcome was uncertain.
• **Date formulas** — Avoided unnecessary recalculation of `today()` formulas while retaining refreshes when the date or time zone changed.

#### Bug Fixes

• Fixed row edits and access restrictions across peek navigation, and restored Escape dismissal after editing.
• Fixed relation-picker searches by database name and restored icon and image-upload choices on row pages and templates.
• Fixed opening supported local attachments, fullscreen video playback, and YouTube audio downloads while preserving the video's default audio track.
• Fixed workspace selection after deleting the active workspace and allowed failed space-creation dialogs to close without a server connection.

#### ⚠️ Action Required

• Self-hosted workspaces require **AppFlowy Cloud v0.19.10 or later**. Upgrade the server before upgrading to desktop v0.14.10.
